# Synthetic evaluation fixtures

Every record in this directory is fictional and exists only to validate the v0.1 JSON contracts and test data handling.

- The organization and opportunity do not exist.
- example.com is a reserved example domain; never treat it as a real source.
- The excerpt is synthetic and is not copied from a publisher.
- IDs, dates and hashes are test values, not production identifiers.

These fixtures must never be used as business data or as evidence that a live source was tested.
